_doc: Director-approved map emblems for the special encounters (owner approved the proposal with these emblems, enc-specials 2026-10-21). Generated by Codex image runs from the prompts in spec/peer_benchmark/encounter_redesign/emblems/, with references assets/art/icons/map/{fight,relic,scavenger,campfire,lantern}.png. The 1024x1024 masters use the map icons' near-black ground (7,7,11); clipped inside the room medallion at runtime like the existing room emblems. These hashes identify the approved masters. Ember Hoarder ships at 128x128 (see assets/_masters/perf-153/provenance.md). Warband, Umbral Snare, and Last Light ship at 160x160 (see assets/_masters/perf-155/provenance.json).
